Questions
Does anything post without me?
No. Each draft waits for your approval. An account posts on its own only after it earns auto-approve and you turn it on.
What if I approve by mistake?
Press Z or Undo within 60 seconds. The draft returns to your queue.
How does it post?
It posts through each platform's official API with the access you grant. It never uses a browser.
Does it reply or comment?
Only to people who comment on, mention or reply to your account. Each reply waits in your inbox until you approve it.
Which platforms does it post to?
Posts to Bluesky, LinkedIn and YouTube today.
LinkedIn means personal profiles.
X, Threads, Instagram, Facebook Pages and TikTok are coming soon.
What does the AI know about my product?
It knows only the facts you list. A draft with a claim missing from your facts is refused and written again.
Tomorrow's posts can be waiting for you tonight.
The free plan needs no card. AI plans cost $9 or $19 a month.
